bio: Emma started GreenLoop to replace single-use packaging with compostable alternatives for small food brands.
story: She began with one prototype in a shared kitchen and now supplies brands across northern Europe.

bio: Rajan built Mehta Logistics from a two-truck business into a national freight network.
story: He still reviews new routes personally and mentors first-time founders in his city.

bio: Daniel co-founded BrightPath to give schools affordable tools for personalised learning.
story: The platform started in three schools and now serves more than 400.

bio: Sofia launched Casa Health to bring low-cost clinic booking and follow-up care to underserved neighbourhoods.
story: She grew the service through partnerships with local pharmacies and community clinics.
